svg.title: IUS Support Campaign - reconstructed brochure cover
svg.desc: Reconstructed cover layout with source-print logo, support campaign wording and a new manually drawn ten-graduate vector interpretation. The illustration preserves the broad composition, not original facial details or original artist strokes. This is not an exact facsimile. Canvas proportions and paper colour are estimated.

g.title: Interior University Society - source print colour
g.desc: Reconstructed from original supplied print photographs. Outlined Nimbus Sans Bold is a close working substitute, not a verified original font. Right-aligned letters, projecting orange bars, 45-degree left bar cuts. All artwork consists of editable vector paths. Colours are approximations.

g.title: IUS support campaign: ten graduates, interpretive vector redrawing
g.desc: Original manually constructed Bezier drawing informed by the ten-figure composition on the supplied photographed campaign brochure. This is an interpretive replacement, not a recovered original illustration. Every figure is an editable vector group; no raster data or automatic tracing.

g.title: Support Campaign - brochure wording
g.desc: Outlined and fitted sans serif lettering reconstructed from the brochure cover. Approximate typography.
